description.zh: 把支付宝、微信、银行卡账单合并成一本家庭账本：自动识别格式、去重、分类，按月生成收支报告，找出订阅扣费、大额支出和超预算类别，帮你定预算、做月度复盘。
description.en: Merges Alipay, WeChat and bank statements into one household ledger: auto-detects formats, dedupes and categorizes, builds monthly reports, flags subscriptions, large expenses and over-budget categories, and helps set and review budgets.

welcome_message.zh: 把支付宝、微信或银行导出的账单发给我
welcome_message.en: Send me your Alipay, WeChat or bank statement exports

prompt.zh: 我上传了 ___ 的账单（支付宝/微信/银行），帮我合并成账本并自动分类。
prompt.en: I uploaded ___ statements (Alipay/WeChat/bank). Merge them into a ledger and categorize.

prompt.zh: 根据账本生成 ___ 月的收支报告，告诉我花得最多的几类。
prompt.en: Build the income/expense report for ___ and show my top spending categories.

prompt.zh: 帮我找出账本里每月自动扣费的订阅和会员。
prompt.en: Find recurring subscriptions and memberships in my ledger.

prompt.zh: 我每月税后收入约 ___ 元，想存下 ___，根据过去的支出帮我定一份预算。
prompt.en: My monthly take-home is about ___ and I want to save ___. Set a budget from my past spending.

prompt.zh: 对比我的预算 ___，看本月哪些类别超支了、超了多少。
prompt.en: Compare this month with my budget ___ and show which categories are over.

prompt.zh: 看看我的账本，给我 3 条具体的省钱建议，算出每月能省多少。
prompt.en: Review my ledger and give 3 concrete saving actions with monthly amounts.

zh: 每月 1 日「09:00」读取 inbound 里的新账单，合并到家庭账本
每月 2 日「20:00」生成上月收支报告并对比预算
每周日「21:00」汇总本周支出，提醒接近预算上限的类别
每月 5 日「10:00」列出疑似订阅扣费，提醒确认是否还在使用
每季度第一天「09:00」生成季度收支趋势和储蓄率变化
每年 1 月 3 日「10:00」生成上一年的家庭年度账单总结
en: On the 1st of each month at 09:00, merge new statements in inbound into the household ledger
On the 2nd of each month at 20:00, build last month's report and compare with the budget
Every Sunday at 21:00, summarize this week's spending and flag categories near their limit
On the 5th of each month at 10:00, list suspected subscriptions to confirm
On the first day of each quarter at 09:00, report quarterly trends and savings rate
On January 3 at 10:00, produce last year's household spending summary
